# DSH Harness Ecosystem Catalog

> Multilingual catalog of DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugins and ecosystem artifacts: plugins, MCP servers, skills, themes, desktop apps, hosted services, bots and marketplaces. Filter by category, capability and security risk.

## Page types
- Plugin / artifact detail: https://harness-market-ds.refertur.net/p/<slug>/
- Category: https://harness-market-ds.refertur.net/category/<category>/
- Type: https://harness-market-ds.refertur.net/type/<kind>/
- Capability: https://harness-market-ds.refertur.net/capability/<capability>/
- Security report: https://harness-market-ds.refertur.net/security/
- Search: https://harness-market-ds.refertur.net/search/?q=<query>
